nginx: the configuration file /etc/nginx/nginx.conf syntax is ok
# configuration file /etc/nginx/nginx.conf:
events {}
http {
    server { listen 80;
        proxy_set_header Authorization "Bearer topsecret";
        ssl_certificate_key /etc/ssl/private/k.pem;
        location / { proxy_pass http://user:hunter2@app; add_header X-Ok yes; } }
}
# configuration file /etc/nginx/conf.d/x.conf:
server { listen 81; }
